muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿قل يا أيها الناس إنما أنا لكم نذير مبين﴾: يا is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed, a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting; الناس is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾. إنما is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نذير; نذير is the khabar (predicate); and مبين is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿فالذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم مغفرة ورزق كريم﴾: the fāʾ is for drawing a consequence (tafrīʿ); الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; عملوا is conjoined to آمنوا; الصالحات is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مغفرة is a postponed mubtadaʾ; رزق is conjoined to مغفرة; كريم is an adjective (ṣifa) of رزق; and the clause ﴿لهم مغفرة﴾ is the khabar of الذين.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿والذين سعوا في آياتنا معاجزين أولئك أصحاب الجحيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause سعوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; في آياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سعوا﴾; معاجزين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); أولئك is a second mubtadaʾ, and أصحاب الجحيم the khabar (predicate) of the second mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿أولئك أصحاب الجحيم﴾ is the khabar of الذين.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿وما أرسلنا من قبلك من رسول ولا نبي إلا إذا تمنى ألقى الشيطان في أمنيته﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ما is negating; أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent). من قبلك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾, and من is for the starting point (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya). من رسول: من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), and رسول is genitive in form and accusative in position as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أرسلنا﴾. ولا نبي: conjoined to من رسول. إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); إذا is a future adverb, and the clause ﴿تمنى﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the clause ﴿ألقى الشيطان﴾ has no grammatical position; and the conditional clause is in the position of the accusative as a disconnected exception. في أمنيته is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ألقى﴾.
﴿فينسخ الله ما يلقي الشيطان ثم يحكم الله آياته﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ينسخ الله is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; ما is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يلقي الشيطان﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿فينسخ الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ثم is a conjunction; يحكم الله is a verb and its fāʿil; and آياته is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿والله عليم حكيم﴾: the wāw: resumptive; the Name of Majesty (Allah) is the mubtadaʾ (subject); عليم: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; حكيم: a second khabar; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿ليجعل ما يلقي الشيطان فتنة للذين في قلوبهم مرض والقاسية قلوبهم﴾: the lām is for causation, and the verb after it is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يُحْكِمُ﴾, i.e. "then Allah makes His signs firm, in order to make…", or attached to ﴿ينسخ﴾. ﴿ما﴾ is relative or maṣdariyya, and it is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يلقي الشيطان﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; فتنة is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of فتنة; ﴿في قلوبهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مرض is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿في قلوبهم مرض﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; القاسية: conjoined to الذين; and قلوبهم is the fāʿil (agent) of القاسية.
﴿وإن الظالمين لفي شقاق بعيد﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or resumptive; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and الظالمين is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿في شقاق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إن; بعيد is an adjective of شقاق; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿وليعلم الذين أوتوا العلم أنه الحق من ربك فيؤمنوا به فتخبت له قلوبهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ليعلم is conjoined to ليجعل; الذين is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أوتوا العلم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; العلم is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أوتوا; ﴿أنه الحق﴾ takes the place of the two objects of يعلم; من ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) [Translator's note: so in the source, «من ربهم»; the ayah has «من ربك»]. فيؤمنوا: conjoined to يعلم; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤمنوا﴾. فتخبت: conjoined to فيؤمنوا; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تخبت﴾; and قلوبهم is the fāʿil.
﴿وإن الله لهاد الذين آمنوا إلى صراط مستقيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun. لهاد: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and هاد is the khabar (predicate) of إن; الذين is a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, by way of the annexation of the active participle to its object, since it is an active participle; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; and إلى صراط مستقيم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿هاد﴾.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿ولا يزال الذين كفروا في مرية منه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا يزال is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb (of kāna and its sisters); الذين كفروا is its noun; في مرية is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); and منه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of مرية.
﴿حتى تأتيهم الساعة بغتة أو يأتيهم عذاب يوم عقيم﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and of the genitive; تأتيهم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the "being settled" (istiqrār) to which ﴿في مرية﴾ is attached. الساعة is the fāʿil (agent); بغتة is a ḥāl (circumstantial); أو is a conjunction; يأتيهم is conjoined to تأتيهم; ﴿عذاب يوم﴾ is the fāʿil; and عقيم is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿الملك يومئذ لله يحكم بينهم﴾: الملك is the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) to which ﴿لله﴾ is attached; إذٍ: a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being "on the day when the Hour or the punishment comes to them". ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يحكم بينهم﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; and ﴿بينهم﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿يحكم﴾.
﴿فالذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات في جنات النعيم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; الذين is the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿وعملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to the clause آمنوا; ﴿في جنات النعيم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿والذين كفروا وكذبوا بآياتنا فأولئك لهم عذاب مهين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿كذبوا بآياتنا﴾ is conjoined to the clause كفروا. فأولئك: the fāʾ is linking, because of the scent of condition in the relative noun; أولئك is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ; مهين is an adjective (ṣifa); the clause ﴿لهم عذاب مهين﴾ is the khabar of أولئك; and the clause ﴿فأولئك لهم عذاب مهين﴾ is the khabar of الذين.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿والذين هاجروا في سبيل الله ثم قتلوا أو ماتوا ليرزقنهم الله رزقا حسنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); هاجروا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿هاجروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; في سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun plus a muḍāf ilayhi, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿هاجروا﴾. ثم is a conjunction; قُتِلُوا is a past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿قتلوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause هاجروا. أو is a conjunction; ماتوا is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿ماتوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause قتلوا. ليرزقنهم: the lām occurs in the response to an oath; يرزقنهم is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the Name of Majesty (Allah) is the fāʿil; رزقًا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); حسنًا is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿ليرزقنهم الله ...﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of الذين.
﴿وإن الله لهو خير الرازقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and ﴿خير﴾ is the khabar of هو; الرازقين is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿هو خير الرازقين﴾ is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿ليدخلنهم مدخلا يرضونه﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; يدخلنهم is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يدخلنهم﴾ is the response to the oath; مدخلا is a second mafʿūl bihi, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is a mīmī maṣdar, or an adverb of place; and the clause ﴿يرضونه﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of مدخلا.
﴿وإن الله لعليم حليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); عليم is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and حليم a second khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿ذلك﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "the matter is that".
﴿ومن عاقب بمثل ما عوقب به ثم بغي عليه لينصرنه الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. مَن is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; عاقب is a past verb; بمثل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عاقب﴾; ما is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi; عوقب is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he"; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عوقب﴾; the clause ﴿عوقب به﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. ثم is a conjunction; بغى is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named; عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil; the clause ﴿بغي عليه﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿عاقب﴾. لينصرنه: the lām occurs in the response to an oath; ينصرنه is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the Name of Majesty (Allah) is the fāʿil (agent); and the oath clause is the khabar of مَن.
﴿إن الله لعفو غفور﴾: a causal clause with no grammatical position. ﴿إن الله﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); عفو is the khabar of إن, and غفور a second khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿ذلك بأن الله يولج الليل في النهار ويولج النهار في الليل وأن الله سميع بصير﴾: the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject). بأن الله: the bāʾ is a causal preposition; أن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; the clause ﴿يولج الليل في النهار﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أن. يولج الليل: a verb, a latent fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في النهار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يولج﴾. The clause ﴿بأن الله ...﴾ etc., made up of the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to the khabar of ﴿ذلك﴾. ويولج النهار في الليل: conjoined to the clause ﴿يولج الليل﴾. وأن الله: أن is an abrogating particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; سميع is the khabar of أن, and بصير a second khabar of أن; and the clause ﴿أن الله سميع بصير﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بأن الله ...﴾.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿ذلك بأن الله هو الحق﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject). بأن الله: the bāʾ is a causal preposition. أن الله: أن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and الحق the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هو﴾, and the mubtadaʾ and khabar are in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أن; or: هو is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) and what follows it is the khabar of أن. The clause ﴿بأن الله هو الحق﴾, made up of the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of ذلك.
﴿وأن ما يدعون من دونه هو الباطل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أن is an abrogating particle; ما is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of أن; يدعون is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); من دونه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and الباطل the khabar of هو, and the mubtadaʾ and khabar are in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أن; or: هو is a pronoun of separation and what follows it is the khabar of أن. The clause ﴿وأن ما يدعون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بأن الله ...﴾.
﴿وأن الله هو العلي الكبير﴾: conjoined to ﴿بأن الله ...﴾. وأن الله: أن is an abrogating particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and العلي الكبير are two khabars of ﴿هو﴾, the clause being the khabar of أن; or هو is a pronoun of separation and العلي الكبير are two khabars of أن.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الله أنزل من السماء ماء فتصبح الأرض مخضرة﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; لم is a particle of negation, of inversion (to the past) and of the jussive; تر is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you"; أن and what falls within its scope take the place of the two objects of تر, since it is (a verb) of knowledge; the clause أنزل is the khabar (predicate) of أن; من السماء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزل﴾; ماء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). فتصبح: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and تصبح is conjoined to أنزل; تصبح is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb (of kāna and its sisters), الأرض is the noun of تصبح, and مخضرة its khabar. It is also said: تصبح is complete (tāmma), الأرض is the fāʿil, and مخضرة is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن الله لطيف خبير﴾: the clause gives the cause of what precedes. إن الله: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; لطيف is the khabar of إن, and خبير a second khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: the clause is circumstantial, or resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿له﴾ is a fronted khabar (predicate); ما is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); في السماوات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and ما في الأرض is conjoined to ما في السماوات.
﴿وإن الله لهو الغني الحميد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. وإن الله: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿هو الغني﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and khabar; الحميد is a second khabar of هو; and the clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الله سخر لكم ما في الأرض والفلك تجري في البحر بأمره﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; لم is a particle of negation, of inversion (to the past) and of the jussive; تر is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم. أن الله: أن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; the clause سخر is the khabar (predicate) of أن; the clause ﴿أن الله ...﴾ takes the place of the two objects of تر. ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سخر﴾; ما is the object of سخر; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; الفلك is conjoined to ما; the clause تجري is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الفلك; في البحر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجري﴾; and بأمره is a ḥāl.
﴿ويمسك السماء أن تقع على الأرض إلا بإذنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يمسك is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He"; السماء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن تقع﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); ﴿على الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تقع﴾; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿بإذنه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿وهو الذي أحياكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and الذي the khabar (predicate); the clause أحياكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, a clause with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿وهو الذي أحياكم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ثم is a conjunction for delay; يميتكم is a verb, a latent fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ثم is likewise a conjunction of delay; يحييكم is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن الإنسان لكفور﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position, conveying the cause of the failure to take heed and see clearly after these lessons and proofs. إن الإنسان: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and الإنسان is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and كفور is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿لكل أمة جعلنا منسكا هم ناسكوه﴾: the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿لكل أمة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted second object of جعلنا; منسكًا is the first object; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and ناسكوه the khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿هم ناسكوه﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of منسكًا.
﴿فلا ينازعنك في الأمر﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); لا is prohibitive; ينازعنك is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the nūn; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents, is the wāw of the plural, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it has not caused the imperfect verb to become indeclinable because it is not directly attached to it; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and في الأمر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينازعنك﴾.
﴿وادع إلى ربك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ادع is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you"; and إلى ربك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ادع﴾.
﴿إنك لعلى هدى مستقيم﴾: a causal clause with no grammatical position. إنك: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿على هدى﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إن; and مستقيم is an adjective of هدى.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿وإن جادلوك فقل الله أعلم بما تعملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; جادلوك is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). فقل: the fāʾ is linking, and قل is an imperative verb; الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and أعلم the khabar (predicate); بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; تعملون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿الله أعلم بما تعملون﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿فقل﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿الله يحكم بينكم يوم القيامة فيما كنتم فيه تختلفون﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يحكم the khabar (predicate); بينكم is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحكم﴾; يوم is an adverb also attached to ﴿يحكم﴾, and القيامة is muḍāf ilayhi; فيما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يحكم﴾; the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. كنتم: كان is an abrogating particle [Translator's note: so in the source, «حرف ناسخ»; كان is an abrogating verb (of kāna and its sisters)], and the tāʾ is its noun; فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تختلفون﴾; تختلفون is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause تختلفون is the khabar of كنتم.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿ألم تعلم أن الله يعلم ما في السماء والأرض﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; لم is a particle of negation, of inversion (to the past) and of the jussive; تعلم is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you"; أن and what falls within its scope take the place of the two objects of يعلم [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb meant is تعلم]. أن الله: أن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; the clause يعلم is the khabar (predicate) of أن; ما is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and الأرض is conjoined to السماء.
﴿إن ذلك في كتاب﴾: a clause giving the cause of what preceded. إن ذلك: إن is an abrogating particle, and ذلك is its noun; في كتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إن.
﴿إن ذلك على الله يسير﴾: likewise a causal clause. إن is an abrogating particle, ذلك is its noun, and يسير is the khabar of إن; على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسير﴾.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿ويعبدون من دون الله ما لم ينزل به سلطانا وما ليس لهم به علم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يعبدون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿من دون الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿لم ينزل﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿سلطانًا﴾ and was placed before it; سلطانًا is the mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿ويعبدون من دون الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ما: conjoined to the first ما; the clause ﴿ليس﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ليس; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to علم; and علم is the postponed noun of ليس.
﴿وما للظالمين من نصير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; للظالمين is a fronted khabar; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and نصير is genitive in form, nominative in position, as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا بينات تعرف في وجوه الذين كفروا المنكر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition, and the clause تتلى is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of إذا to it; تتلى is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تتلى﴾; آياتنا is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); بينات is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause تعرف has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of إذا; في وجوه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تعرف﴾; الذين is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and المنكر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يكادون يسطون بالذين يتلون عليهم آياتنا﴾: the clause يكادون is a ḥāl from الذين, or a ḥāl from ﴿وجوه﴾, since faces are used to express their owners. ﴿يكادون﴾ is one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba); the wāw is its noun, and the clause يسطون is its khabar (predicate); بالذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسطون﴾; the clause يتلون is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتلون﴾; and آياتنا is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قل أفأنبئكم بشر من ذلكم النار وعدها الله الذين كفروا﴾: قل: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you"; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أفأنبئكم﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is conjoining to something omitted, i.e. "I address you and so inform you". أنبئكم: an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi. بِشَرٍ: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنبئكم﴾. من ذلكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شر﴾. النار: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); or النار is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause ﴿وعدها﴾. The clause ﴿النار وعدها...﴾ is resumptive, or explicative of the evil mentioned before, as though it were said: ﴿ما الأكثر شرًّا من ذلك؟ فقيل: النار وعدها الله...﴾ ("What is more evil than that?" and it was said: "The Fire, which Allah has promised…") [Translator's note: the source places this paraphrase inside Quranic brackets ﴿…﴾, but it is not Quranic text]; on both views it has no grammatical position. The clause ﴿وعدها الله...﴾ is either a second khabar of the omitted mubtadaʾ or a khabar of ﴿النار﴾. ﴿وعدها الله﴾: a past verb, a fronted second mafʿūl bihi and a postponed fāʿil. الذين: the first mafʿūl bihi of ﴿وعدها﴾; and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وبئس المصير﴾: the wāw is resumptive. بئس: a rigid (jāmid) past verb of blame; المصير is the fāʿil; and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "it".

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس ضرب مثل فاستمعوا له﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position. يا is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed, a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting; الناس is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; ضرب is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and مثل is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). فاستمعوا: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); استمعوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿له﴾ is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استمعوا﴾.
﴿إن الذين تدعون من دون الله لن يخلقوا ذبابا ولو اجتمعوا له﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); الذين is an indeclinable relative noun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إن; the clause ﴿تدعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿إن الذين تدعون...﴾ is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), with no grammatical position. ﴿من دون الله﴾ is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿لن يخلقوا ذبابًا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; ذبابًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ولو: the wāw conjoins to something omitted which is a ḥāl, i.e. "their creating a fly is negated in every circumstance, even in this circumstance in which they gather together for it". لو is conditional; اجتمعوا is a verb and its fāʿil; and ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اجتمعوا﴾.
﴿وإن يسلبهم الذباب شيئا لا يستنقذوه منه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; يسلبهم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; الذباب is the fāʿil; شيئًا is a second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿لا يستنقذوه﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ): لا is negating, يستنقذوه is an imperfect verb, the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; منه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يستنقذوه﴾.
﴿ضعف الطالب والمطلوب﴾: ضعف is a past verb, الطالب is the fāʿil, and المطلوب is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الطالب; the clause ﴿ضعف الطالب والمطلوب﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿ما قدروا الله حق قدره﴾: ما is negating; ﴿قدروا الله﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; حق: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is its adjective, the implied form being "they did not estimate Allah with His true estimation"; قدره: muḍāf ilayhi, and it is itself muḍāf; and the hāʾ: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إن الله لقوي عزيز﴾: a causal clause. إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); قوي is the first khabar (predicate) of إن, and عزيز the second khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿الله يصطفي من الملائكة رسلا ومن الناس﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يصطفي﴾ the khabar (predicate); من الملائكة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿رسلا﴾ and was placed before it; or attached to ﴿يصطفي﴾; رسلا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and من الناس is conjoined to ﴿من الملائكة﴾.
﴿إن الله سميع بصير﴾: a causal clause. إن is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty (Allah) is its noun; سميع is the first khabar of إن, and بصير its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم﴾: the clause ﴿يعلم﴾ is a third khabar (predicate) of إن, or resumptive with no grammatical position. يعلم is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He"; ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بين أيديهم﴾: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and ما خلفهم is conjoined to ﴿ما بين أيديهم﴾.
﴿وإلى الله ترجع الأمور﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إلى الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ترجع﴾; ترجع is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); and الأمور is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:77-77.t: ﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا اركعوا واسجدوا واعبدوا ربكم وافعلوا الخير لعلكم تفلحون﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed, a specified indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting; الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. اركعوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; اسجدوا is conjoined to اركعوا, an imperative verb indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. واعبدوا: the wāw is a conjunction; اعبدوا is an imperative verb indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and ربكم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). وافعلوا: the wāw is a conjunction; افعلوا is an imperative verb indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and الخير is the mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿لعلكم تفلحون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. لعلكم: لعل is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), the kāf is its noun, and the clause ﴿تفلحون﴾ is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿وجاهدوا في الله حق جهاده﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and جاهدوا is likewise conjoined; جاهدوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); في الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاهدوا﴾. A muḍāf must be taken as omitted, after the omission of the object of جاهدوا, i.e. "strive against your enemies for the sake of Allah's very Self and on His account", so في is causal. ﴿حق﴾ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿جهاده﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and it is itself muḍāf; and the hāʾ: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿هو اجتباكم وما جعل عليكم في الدين من حرج﴾: هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause اجتباكم the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿هو اجتباكم﴾ is causal. وما: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negating; جعل is a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He"; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿جعل﴾; في الدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and حرج is genitive in form, accusative in position, because it is the first object of جعل.
﴿ملة أبيكم إبراهيم﴾: ﴿ملة﴾ is made accusative by the import of what precedes it, as though He said: "He made your religion spacious with the spaciousness of the creed of your father", then the muḍāf was omitted and the muḍāf ilayhi put in its place; or it is accusative by way of specification (ikhtiṣāṣ), i.e. "I mean specifically by the religion the creed of your father"; or by an implied hidden verb whose implied form is "follow". أبيكم is muḍāf ilayhi, and إبراهيم is a badal (substitute) from أبيكم.
﴿هو سماكم المسلمين من قبل وفي هذا ليكون الرسول شهيدا عليكم وتكونوا شهداء على الناس﴾: هو is a mubtadaʾ and the clause سماكم its khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl from إبراهيم; سماكم is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a first mafʿūl bihi; المسلمين is the second mafʿūl bihi; من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "before this Book"; وفي هذا is conjoined to من قبل, i.e. "and in this Quran". ليكون: the lām is for causation or for outcome (ʿāqiba); يكون is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿سماكم﴾; الرسول is the noun of يكون, and شهيدًا the khabar of يكون; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شهيدًا﴾. ﴿وتكونوا شهداء على الناس﴾ is conjoined to its counterpart. تكونوا: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb (of kāna and its sisters); the wāw is its noun and شهداء its khabar; ﴿على الناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شهداء﴾.
﴿فأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة واعتصموا بالله هو مولاكم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); أقيموا الصلاة is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and what follows is conjoined to it. وآتوا الزكاة is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined to ﴿أقيموا الصلاة﴾; اعتصموا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined to ﴿أقيموا الصلاة﴾; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اعتصموا﴾; ﴿هو مولاكم﴾ is a circumstantial clause from الله; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and مولاكم the khabar.
﴿فنعم المولى ونعم النصير﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. نعم is a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise; المولى is the fāʿil; the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, i.e. "He"; and نعم النصير is conjoined to نعم المولى. نعم is a rigid past verb for expressing praise, النصير is the fāʿil, and the one specified for praise is omitted, i.e. "He".

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس اتقوا ربكم﴾: يا is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾: one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; ﴿ها﴾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الناس: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; اتقوا: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ربكم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa, and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إن زلزلة الساعة شيء عظيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); زلزلة: the noun (ism) of إن; الساعة: muḍāf ilayhi; شيء: the khabar (predicate) of إن; عظيم: a naʿt of شيء; the clause ﴿إن زلزلة الساعة ...﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿يوم ترونها تذهل كل مرضعة عما أرضعت وتضع كل ذات حمل حملها﴾: يوم: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تذهل﴾; the clause ﴿ترونها﴾ is in the position of genitive through the adverb's being annexed to it; تذهل: imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿كل مرضعة﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿تذهل ...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿عما أرضعت﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تذهل﴾, and ما is relative (mawṣūla); ﴿تضع كل﴾: imperfect verb and fāʿil; the clause ﴿تضع﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿تذهل﴾; ﴿ذات حمل﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿حملها﴾: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تضع.
﴿وترى الناس سكارى وما هم بسكارى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ترى: an imperfect verb conjoined to ترونها, the fāʿil of ترى being latent (mustatir), its implied form being أنت; الناس: mafʿūl bihi; سكارى: ḥāl (circumstantial); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāl); ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā that operates like laysa; ﴿هم﴾: the noun (ism) of mā; ﴿بسكارى﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿سكارى﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ; the clause ﴿وما هم بسكارى﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from الناس.
﴿ولكن عذاب الله شديد﴾: the wāw conjoins to something omitted, i.e.: "all this is light, but the punishment of Allah is severe".

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿ومن الناس من يجادل في الله بغير علم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿من الناس﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿مَن﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يجادل في الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position; ﴿في الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجادل﴾; ﴿بغير علم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) agent pronoun in يجادل, i.e.: "he disputes, being ignorant".
﴿ويتبع كل شيطان مريد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿يتبع﴾ is conjoined to يجادل; ﴿كل﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); شيطان: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); مريد: a naʿt (adjective) of شيطان; a muḍāf must be implied, i.e.: "the footsteps of every devil".

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿كتب عليه أنه من تولاه فأنه يضله ويهديه إلى عذاب السعير﴾: كتب: a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); عليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كتب﴾; أنّ and what lies within its scope are in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿مَن﴾: a conditional noun causing the jussive, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿فأنه﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يضله﴾ is the khabar of the second أنه; the conditional clause is the khabar of the first أنه; يهديه: conjoined to يضله; ﴿إلى عذاب السعير﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يهديه﴾.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس إن كنتم في ريب من البعث فإنا خلقناكم من تراب ثم من نطفة ثم من علقة ثم من مضغة مخلقة وغير مخلقة لنبين لكم﴾: ﴿يا أيها الناس﴾: يا is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾: one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; ﴿ها﴾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الناس: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾. إن is conditional; كنتم: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun (ism); في ريب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); ﴿من البعث﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of ريب. فإنا: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause ﴿خلقناكم﴾ is its khabar; من تراب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلقناكم﴾; ثم is a conjunction expressing delay (tarākhī) in the stages of creation; His saying مخلقة is a naʿt of مضغة; غير مخلقة: conjoined to مخلقة; لنبين: the lām is causal (taʿlīl); نبين: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām of cause; the lām with what it governs, ﴿لنبيِّن﴾, is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خلقناكم﴾; or the lām is of becoming and outcome (ṣayrūra wa-ʿāqiba). The object of نبين is omitted; ﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نبين﴾.
﴿ونقر في الأرحام ما نشاء إلى أجل مسمى﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; نقر: imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being نحن; في الأرحام: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نقر﴾; ما: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause نشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; إلى أجل مسمى: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ثم نخرجكم طفلا ثم لتبلغوا أشدكم﴾: ثم is a conjunction; نخرجكم is conjoined to نقر; the fāʿil of نخرجكم is a latent pronoun, its implied form being نحن, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; طفلا: a ḥāl from the object of نخرجكم. ثم لتبلغوا: a verb must be implied, i.e.: "then We give you life so that you reach your full strength". لتبلغوا: the lām is causal or of becoming (ṣayrūra); تبلغوا is accusative by an implied أن after the lām, and the wāw is the fāʿil; أشدكم: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ومنكم من يتوفى ومنكم من يرد إلى أرذل العمر لكيلا يعلم من بعد علم شيئا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; منكم: a fronted khabar; مَن: the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يتوفى﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; منكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; مَن: the postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يرد﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿إلى أرذل العمر﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرد﴾; لكيلا: the lām is a preposition, and ﴿كي﴾ is a maṣdar-forming and accusative particle, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يرد﴾; ﴿من بعد﴾ علم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, because علم here means "knew/recognised" (ʿarafa); ﴿شيئًا﴾: the mafʿūl bihi of يعلم.
﴿وترى الأرض هامدة فإذا أنزلنا عليها الماء اهتزت وربت وأنبتت من كل زوج بهيج﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; ترى: a past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; ترى is an imperfect verb], its fāʿil latent, its implied form being أنت; الأرض: mafʿūl bihi; هامدة: a ḥāl from الأرض. فإذا: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition; the clause ﴿أنزلنا﴾ is in the position of genitive through the adverb's being annexed to it; ﴿عليها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنزلنا﴾; الماء: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿اهتزت﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of a non-jussive condition; ربت: conjoined to اهتزت, and likewise His saying ﴿وأنبتت﴾; ﴿من كل زوج﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e.: "it brought forth things or kinds being of every pair"; ﴿بهيج﴾: a naʿt of زوج.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿ذلك بأن الله هو الحق﴾: ذلك: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿بأن الله هو الحق﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; ﴿أن الله﴾: أنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the word of majesty (Allah) is its noun (ism); ﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ; الحق: khabar (predicate); the mubtadaʾ and its khabar ﴿هو الحق﴾ are the khabar of أن, in the position of nominative; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك.
﴿وأنه يحيي الموتى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنه is conjoined to بأن; ﴿أنه﴾: أنّ is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿يحيي الموتى﴾ is its khabar.
﴿وأنه على كل شيء قدير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنه: أنّ is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; ﴿على كل شيء﴾: preposition, genitive noun and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿قدير﴾; قدير: the khabar of أن.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وأن الساعة آتية لا ريب فيها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أن الساعة is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "and the matter is that the Hour…". أن الساعة: أنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and الساعة is its noun (ism); ﴿آتية﴾: its khabar; لا is the lā of generic negation; ريب: the noun of lā; فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of lā; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or a second khabar of أنّ.
﴿وأن الله يبعث من في القبور﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنّ is an abrogating particle, and the word of majesty (Allah) is its noun; the clause ﴿يبعث﴾ is its khabar; مَن: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في القبور﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿ومن الناس من يجادل في الله بغير علم ولا هدى ولا كتاب منير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من الناس: a fronted khabar (predicate); مَن: a relative noun in the position of nominative as the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يجادل﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position; في الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجادل﴾, with a muḍāf omitted, i.e.: "His power, His attributes and His religion"; ﴿بغير﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) agent pronoun in يجادل, i.e.: "he disputes, being ignorant"; ﴿علم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿ومن الناس...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿لا هدى﴾: conjoined to علم; ﴿لا كتاب﴾: also conjoined; منير: a naʿt (adjective) of كتاب.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿ثاني عطفه ليضل عن سبيل الله﴾: ثاني: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of يجادل; عطفه: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿ليضل﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl) or of outcome and becoming (ʿāqiba wa-ṣayrūra); يضل: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجادل﴾; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being هو; ﴿عن سبيل الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يضل﴾.
﴿له في الدنيا خزي ونذيقه يوم القيامة عذاب الحريق﴾: له: a fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿في الدنيا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was a naʿt (adjective) of خزي and was placed before it; ﴿خزي﴾: the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ونذيقه: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿نذيقه﴾: verb, a latent fāʿil, and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿يوم القيامة﴾: an adverb attached to ﴿نذيقه﴾; ﴿عذاب الحريق﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿له في الدنيا ...﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿ذلك بما قدمت يداك وأن الله ليس بظلام للعبيد﴾: ذلك: mubtadaʾ (subject); بما: khabar (predicate); قدمت: the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; يداك: fāʿil (agent); أن الله: أنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the word of majesty (Allah) is its noun (ism); ﴿ليس بظلام للعبيد﴾: the noun of ليس is latent (mustatir), its implied form being هو; the bāʾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; ظلام is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of ليس; للعبيد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ظلام; the clause ﴿ليس بظلام للعبيد﴾ is the khabar of أن; the clause ﴿وأنّ الله ...﴾ is conjoined to the genitive ﴿ما﴾, so it is in the position of genitive; the clause ﴿ذلك بما قدمت يداك﴾ is the speech (maqūl) of an omitted verb of saying, and the clause of saying is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿ومن الناس من يعبد الله على حرف﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive; من الناس: a fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿مَن﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يعبد الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position; ﴿على حرف﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of يعبد, i.e.: "wavering"; the clause is conjoined, resumptive [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably "conjoined, or resumptive"], with no grammatical position.
﴿فإن أصابه خير اطمأن به وإن أصابته فتنة انقلب على وجهه خسر الدنيا والآخرة﴾: فإن: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إن is conditional; أصابه: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); خير: fāʿil; اطمأن: a past verb in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اطمأن﴾; إن: conjoined to the first إن; أصابته: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis, the tāʾ being a particle of the feminine and the hāʾ the mafʿūl bihi; فتنة: fāʿil; انقلب: the apodosis; ﴿على وجهه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause ﴿خسر الدنيا والآخرة﴾ is also a ḥāl from the fāʿil of انقلب; الدنيا: the object of خسر; الآخرة: conjoined to الدنيا.
﴿ذلك هو الخسران المبين﴾: ذلك: mubtadaʾ; ﴿هو﴾: a second mubtadaʾ; الخسران: the khabar of هو; the clause ﴿هو الخسران﴾ is the khabar of ذلك; or ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) and ﴿الخسران﴾ is the khabar of ذلك; المبين: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الخسران﴾; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿يدعو من دون الله ما لا يضره وما لا ينفعه﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; يدعو: imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو; ﴿من دون الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ما: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لا is negating; the clause ﴿لا يضره﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿ما لا ينفعه﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿ذلك هو الضلال البعيد﴾: ﴿ذلك﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿هو﴾: a second mubtadaʾ; ﴿الضلال﴾: the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هو﴾; the clause ﴿هو الضلال﴾ is the khabar of ﴿ذلك﴾; or ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) and ﴿الضلال﴾ is the khabar of ﴿ذلك﴾; ﴿البعيد﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of الضلال; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t: ﴿يدعو لمن ضره أقرب من نفعه لبئس المولى ولبئس العشير﴾: the clause is a badal (substitute) from the preceding clause يدعو, with no grammatical position; يدعو: imperfect verb; the lām is of inception (ibtidāʾ), or occurs in the answer of an oath; مَن: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the verb يدعو is one of the verbs of the heart (afʿāl al-qulūb), containing the meaning of "he claims" (yazʿumu); the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: ﴿آلهة﴾ ("gods"); ضره: a second mubtadaʾ; ﴿أقرب﴾: the khabar of ضره; من نفعه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقرب﴾; the clause ﴿ضره أقرب من نفعه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿لمن ضره أقرب من نفعه﴾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because the lām of inception suspends the verb from operating on it (taʿlīq). ﴿بئس﴾: a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; المولى: fāʿil (agent); the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being: هو; ولبئس العشير is conjoined to His saying: ﴿لبئس المولى﴾.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿إن الله يدخل الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; إن الله: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the word of majesty (Allah) is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿يدخل﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; الذين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿عملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to آمنوا; جنات: second mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), or accusative by removal of the preposition; the clause ﴿تجري من تحتها النهار﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the Quranic text is تجري من تحتها الأنهار] is a naʿt (adjective) of جنات.
﴿إن الله يفعل ما يريد﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position, and it gives the reason for what precedes. إن الله: إن is an abrogating particle, and the word of majesty is its noun; the clause ﴿يفعل﴾ is the khabar of إن; the fāʿil (agent) of يفعل is latent (mustatir), its implied form being هو; ما: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿من كان يظن أن لن ينصره الله في الدنيا والآخرة﴾: مَن: conditional, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). كان: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the noun (ism) of كان being latent (mustatir), referring to ﴿من﴾; the clause ﴿يظن﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كان; أن is lightened from the heavy (anna), its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause ﴿لن ينصره الله﴾ is the khabar of أن; أن and what follows it fill the place of the two objects of يظن; ﴿في الدنيا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينصره﴾; الآخرة: conjoined to الدنيا.
﴿فليمدد بسبب إلى السماء ثم ليقطع فلينظر هل يذهبن كيده ما يغيظ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the lām is the lām of command; يمدد: imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, its fāʿil (agent) latent, its implied form being هو; بسبب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يمدد﴾; إلى السماء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of سبب. ﴿ثم ليقطع﴾: conjoined to فليمدد; ﴿هل﴾: an interrogative particle; يذهبن: imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; كيده: fāʿil; ﴿ما﴾: the object of يذهبن; the clause ﴿يغيظ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿هل يذهبن﴾ is in the place of accusative by ﴿ينظر﴾.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿وكذلك أنزلناه آيات بينات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: "and with the like of that wondrous sending-down did We send it down"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿أنزلناه﴾: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); آيات: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in أنزلناه; بينات: a naʿt.
﴿وأن الله يهدي من يريد﴾: the wāw conjoins to the hāʾ of أنزلناه, the meaning being: "We sent down that Allah guides whomever He wills to guide". Or the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and أنّ and what lies within its scope are in the position of nominative for an implied (muḍmar) mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "and the matter is that Allah guides whom He wills". أن الله: أنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the word of majesty (Allah) is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿يهدي﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أن; مَن: the object of يهدي; the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿إن الذين آمنوا والذين هادوا والصابئين والنصارى والمجوس والذين أشركوا إن الله يفصل بينهم يوم القيامة﴾: إن الذين: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and الذين is its noun (ism); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; what follows is conjoined to الذين; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya); the second إن with its noun and its khabar (predicate), ﴿إن الله يفصل ...﴾, is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the first إن. The clause ﴿يفصل بينهم﴾ is the khabar of the second إن; بينهم: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يفصل﴾; يوم: an adverb attached to ﴿يفصل﴾; القيامة: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إن الله على كل شيء شهيد﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, and the word of majesty (Allah) is its noun; على كل شيء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شهيد; شهيد: the khabar of إن; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الله يسجد له من في السماوات ومن في الأرض والشمس والقمر والنجوم والجبال والشجر والدواب وكثير من الناس وكثير حق عليه العذاب﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; لم is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; تر: imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being أنت; the "seeing" here is of knowledge (ʿilmiyya); أن الله: أنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the word of majesty (Allah) is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿يسجد له﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسجد﴾; مَن: fāʿil; ﴿في السماوات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, the ṣila clause having no grammatical position; مَن: conjoined to the first ﴿من﴾; ﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative, the ṣila clause having no grammatical position; ﴿الشمس والقمر والنجوم والجبال والشجر والدواب وكثير من الناس﴾ are conjoined items; من الناس: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of كثير; أنّ and what lies within its scope fill the place of the two objects of تر.
﴿وكثير حق عليه العذاب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿كثير﴾: conjoined; the clause ﴿حق عليه العذاب﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿كثير﴾; or ﴿كثير﴾ is mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause ﴿حق عليه العذاب﴾ is the khabar, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes.
﴿ومن يهن الله فما له من مكرم﴾: the wāw is resumptive or a conjunction; مَن is conditional, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يهن﴾; the word of majesty is the fāʿil; ما is negating; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; مِن is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; مكرم: genitive in form by مِن, a mubtadaʾ nominative in position; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or conjoined.
﴿إن الله يفعل ما يشاء﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, and the word of majesty is its noun; the clause يفعل is its khabar; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿هذان خصمان اختصموا في ربهم﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; هذان: mubtadaʾ (subject); خصمان: its khabar (predicate); the clause اختصموا is a naʿt (adjective) of خصمان. Or خصمان is a badal (substitute) from هذان and the clause اختصموا is the khabar; في ربهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اختصموا﴾.
﴿فالذين كفروا قطعت لهم ثياب من نار يصب من فوق رءوسهم الحميم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; الذين: mubtadaʾ; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause قطعت is the khabar; ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قطعت﴾; ثياب: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿من نار﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of ثياب; the clause يصب is a second khabar of the relative noun, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from the pronoun in ﴿لهم﴾, or resumptive with no grammatical position; يصب: an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); من فوق رءوسهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يصب﴾; الحميم: nāʾib fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿يصهر به ما في بطونهم والجلود﴾: يصهر: an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصهر﴾; ما: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); في بطونهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, the ṣila clause having no grammatical position; الجلود: conjoined to ما; the clause ﴿يصهر﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الحميم.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿ولهم مقامع من حديد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مقامع: the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); من حديد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مقامع.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿كلما أرادوا أن يخرجوا منها من غم أعيدوا فيها﴾: ﴿كلما﴾: ﴿كلَّ﴾ stands in for an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعيدوا﴾ and containing the meaning of condition; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya of time (maṣdariyya zamāniyya); the clause ﴿أرادوا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾; ﴿ما﴾ with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by annexation, the implied form being: "every willing", with an omitted muḍāf implied, i.e.: "every time of their willing to go out". Or ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite described noun (nakira mawṣūfa) meaning ﴿وقت﴾ ("time"), with the referent pronoun omitted, the implied form being: "every time in which they wanted to go out", so that the clause ﴿أرادوا﴾ is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾. ﴿أرادوا﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يخرجوا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أرادوا﴾; ﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخرجوا﴾; ﴿من غم﴾: a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from the preposition and genitive noun before it, because it includes it. The clause ﴿أعيدوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of ﴿كلما﴾; فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعيدوا﴾.
﴿وذوقوا عذاب الحريق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the conjoined element is omitted, its implied form being: "and it will be said to them"; the clause ﴿ذوقوا عذاب الحريق﴾ is the speech (maqūl) of the omitted saying; ذوقوا: verb and fāʿil; عذاب: mafʿūl bihi; الحريق: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿إن الله يدخل الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. إن الله: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the word of majesty (Allah) is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿يدخل﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; الذين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿عملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to آمنوا; جنات: second mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), or accusative by removal of the preposition; the clause ﴿تجري من تحتها النهار﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the Quranic text is تجري من تحتها الأنهار] is a naʿt (adjective) of جنات.
﴿يحلون فيها من أساور من ذهب ولؤلؤا﴾: يحلون: an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحلون﴾; من أساور: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of an omitted object, i.e.: "they are adorned with ornaments of bracelets"; من ذهب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of أساور; the clause ﴿يحلون﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الذين; ﴿لؤلؤًا﴾: conjoined to the position of ﴿من أساور﴾, because its position is accusative; and it was said: accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being: "and they are given pearls".
﴿ولباسهم فيها حرير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لباسهم: mubtadaʾ (subject); فيها: ḥāl; حرير: khabar.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿وهدوا إلى الطيب من القول﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; هدوا: a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿إلى الطيب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿هدوا﴾; من القول: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun latent in الطيب.
﴿وهدوا إلى صراط الحميد﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause; هدوا: a past verb in the passive, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; إلى صراط: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿هدوا﴾; الحميد: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا ويصدون عن سبيل الله والمسجد الحرام الذي جعلناه للناس سواء العاكف فيه والباد﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; إن الذين: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and الذين is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of إن; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ويصدون: the wāw is a conjunction, and يصدون is conjoined to كفروا; عن سبيل الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصدون﴾; ﴿المسجد الحرام﴾: conjoined to ﴿سبيل الله﴾; الذي: a second naʿt (adjective) of المسجد; the clause جعلناه is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position; جعلناه: verb and fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); للناس: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was a naʿt and was placed first; سواء: the second object of ﴿جعلناه﴾ if جعل takes two objects; if it takes one object, سواء is parsed as a ḥāl from the hāʾ of جعلناه; العاكف: the fāʿil of سواء, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) used as a description and so has the force of the derived active participle, i.e.: "We made it such that the resident in it is equal… etc." ﴿الباد﴾, with the yāʾ omitted following the script of the Muṣḥaf, is conjoined to العاكف; the khabar (predicate) of إن is omitted, its implied form being "they have lost" or "they have perished" or the like.
﴿ومن يرد فيه بإلحاد بظلم نذقه من عذاب أليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿مَن﴾: a conditional noun causing the jussive, mubtadaʾ (subject); يرد: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); فيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرد﴾; the object of يرد is omitted so as to cover everything it could cover; بإلحاد: ḥāl; بظلم: also a ḥāl; نذقه: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being نحن, and the hāʾ in ﴿نذقه﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; من عذاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نذقه﴾; أليم: a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿وإذ بوأنا لإبراهيم مكان البيت أن لا تشرك بي شيئا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; إذ: a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being: "and remember when We settled"; the clause ﴿بوأنا﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); بوأنا: verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿لإبراهيم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بوأنا﴾; مكان البيت: the object of بوأنا; ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), because it occurs after an implied saying, i.e.: "saying to him: Do not associate"; the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. لا is prohibitive (nāhiya); تشرك: imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; ﴿بي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تشرك﴾; شيئًا: the object of تشرك.
﴿وطهر بيتي للطائفين والقائمين والركع السجود﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; طهر: imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being أنت; بيتي: the object of طهر; للطائفين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿طهر﴾; القائمين and الركع are conjoined to what precedes; ﴿السجود﴾: a badal (substitute) from ﴿الركع﴾, genitive like it.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وأذن في الناس بالحج يأتوك رجالا وعلى كل ضامر يأتين من كل فج عميق﴾: أذن: imperative verb; في الناس: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أذن﴾; بالحج: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "proclaiming"; يأتوك: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it occurs as the answer to the request; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). رجالا: ḥāl; ﴿على كل ضامر﴾ is conjoined to رجالا, i.e.: "they will come to you on foot and riding". ﴿يأتين﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause يأتين is a naʿt (adjective) of كل ضامر; ﴿من كل فج﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتين﴾; عميق: a naʿt of ﴿فج﴾.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿ليشهدوا منافع لهم ويذكروا اسم الله في أيام معلومات على ما رزقهم من بهيمة الأنعام﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl); يشهدوا: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after it; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb after it is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأتوك﴾; منافع: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of منافع; يذكروا: conjoined to يشهدوا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿اسم﴾: mafʿūl bihi; في أيام: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يذكروا﴾; معلومات: a naʿt of أيام; ﴿على ما رزقهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to ﴿يذكروا﴾; ﴿من بهيمة الأنعام﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿رزقهم﴾.
﴿فكلوا منها وأطعموا البائس الفقير﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "eloquent" fāʾ, implying an omitted condition); كلوا: imperative verb and fāʿil; منها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كلوا﴾; أطعموا: conjoined to كلوا; البائس: mafʿūl bihi; الفقير: a naʿt.

zajjaj:15-15.t: His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿مَن كانَ يَظُنُّ أنْ لَنْ يَنْصُرَهُ اللَّهُ في الدُّنْيا والآخِرَةِ﴾ — this hāʾ (the pronoun "him") refers to Muhammad ﷺ, i.e. "Whoever thinks that Allah will not help Muhammad ﷺ until He makes it prevail over all religion, let him die of rage." That is the explanation of His saying: ﴿فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ إلى السَّماءِ﴾. "السبب" is the rope, and "السماء" is the ceiling, i.e. let him tie a rope fast to his ceiling, then cut — that is, let him stretch the rope until it is cut off, so that he dies strangled. ﴿هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهُ ما يَغِيظُ﴾, i.e. will his scheme remove his rage? It has been read "ثُمَّ لِيَقْطَعْ" and "ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ", with kasra on the lām and with it vowelless (sukūn).

zajjaj:17-17.t:
His saying: ﴿إنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا والَّذِينَ هادُوا والصّابِئِينَ والنَّصارى والمَجُوسَ والَّذِينَ أشْرَكُوا إنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهم يَوْمَ القِيامَةِ﴾: Allah will judge between these five sects and the believers.
﴿فالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا قُطِّعَتْ لَهم ثِيابٌ مِن نارٍ﴾ [al-Ḥajj: 19], while the believers enter Paradise, and that is His saying: ﴿إنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وعَمِلُوا الصّالِحاتِ جَنّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِها الأنْهارُ﴾ [al-Ḥajj: 23]. The khabar (predicate) of the first "إنَّ" is the whole clause together with the second "إنَّ". Some people have claimed that your saying "إنَّ زَيْدًا إنَّهُ قائِمٌ" is poor usage, and that this verse is only acceptable because of "الَّذِي" (the relative noun). But there is no difference between "الذي" and anything else in the chapter of "إنَّ": if you say "إنَّ زَيْدًا إنَّهُ قائِمٌ", it is good. Like it is the poet's saying:
؎إنَّ الخَلِيفَةَ إنَّ اللَّهَ سَرْبَلَهُ
(Indeed the caliph — indeed Allah has clothed him…)
There is no disagreement among the Basrans that "إنَّ" may enter upon every mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar: you say "إنَّ زَيْدًا هو قائِمٌ" and "إنَّ زَيْدًا إنَّهُ قائِمٌ".

zajjaj:18-18.t:
His saying: ﴿ألَمْ تَرَ أنَّ اللَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُ مَن في السَّماواتِ ومَن في الأرْضِ والشَّمْسُ والقَمَرُ والنُّجُومُ والجِبالُ والشَّجَرُ والدَّوابُّ وكَثِيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ وكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ العَذابُ﴾: prostration here is submission to Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, and it is obedience from those whom Allah has created, both living creatures and inanimate things.
The proof that it is a prostration of obedience is His saying: ﴿وَكَثِيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ وكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ العَذابُ﴾. This is the best of the interpretations: that it prostrates in obedience to Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, as Allah the Exalted said: ﴿فَقالَ لَها ولِلأرْضِ ائْتِيا طَوْعًا أوْ كَرْهًا قالَتا أتَيْنا طائِعِينَ﴾ [Fuṣṣilat: 11], and as He said: "وَإنَّ مِنها — meaning the stones — لَما يَهْبِطُ مِن خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ". Fear can only exist through what Allah has given it, by which He tests its fear.
Some people said: the prostration of these things which are inanimate, and of the animals that have no reason, is only the trace of the craftsmanship in them, and the submissiveness which shows that they are created. They cited as proof for this the poet's saying:
؎بِجَيْشٍ يَضِلُّ البُلْقُ في حَجَراتِهِ تُرى الأُكْمُ فِيها سُجَّدًا لِلْحَوافِرِ
(With an army in whose flanks the piebald horses are lost, in which the hillocks are seen prostrate before the hooves.)
That is, they have become humbled by the treading of the hooves upon them. They said this because, in their view, prostration that is obedience can only come from one who has reason. What breaks this is what Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, described: that among the stones there are some that fall down out of fear of Allah; and fear and dread we have only understood of human beings, yet Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, has informed us that among the stones there are some that fear Him. And He informed us that He subjected the mountains and the birds together with Dāwūd, glorifying with him. If the glorification of the mountains and birds were the trace of craftsmanship, it would not have been said "سَخَّرْنا" (We subjected), nor "مَعَ داوُدَ الجِبالَ" (with Dāwūd the mountains), because the trace of craftsmanship is evident with Dāwūd and others alike. So it is without doubt a prostration of obedience, and likewise the glorification in the mountains and birds; but we do not know their glorification unless it comes to us in a hadith how that glorification is. And Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, said: ﴿وَإنْ مِن شَيْءٍ إلا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ ولَكِنْ لا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِيحَهُمْ﴾ [al-Isrāʾ: 44].

zajjaj:19-19.t: His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿هَذانِ خَصْمانِ اخْتَصَمُوا في رَبِّهِمْ﴾: the two disputing parties are the believers and the unbelievers. It came in the exegesis that the Jews said to the Muslims: "Our religion is older than your religion, and our Book is older than your Book." The Muslims answered them with: "We believe in what was sent down to us and what was sent down to you, and we believe in Allah, His angels, His Books and His messengers, making no distinction between any of His messengers, while you have disbelieved in some of the messengers." So the argument of the Muslims prevailed over the unbelievers. It says "اخْتَصَمُوا" (plural), though it said "خَصْمانِ" (dual), because they are two groups. ﴿فالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا قُطِّعَتْ لَهم ثِيابٌ مِن نارٍ﴾: it came in the exegesis that the garments of fire are copper that has been melted. His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿يُصَبُّ مِن فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ الحَمِيمُ﴾ ﴿يُصْهَرُ بِهِ ما في بُطُونِهِمْ والجُلُودُ﴾ [al-Ḥajj: 20]: what is in their bellies boils from it until it comes out of their rear ends. This is for one of the two disputing parties.

zajjaj:23-23.t: And He said concerning the disputing party who are believers: ﴿إنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وعَمِلُوا الصّالِحاتِ جَنّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِها الأنْهارُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيها مِن أساوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ ولُؤْلُؤًا﴾ — and "لُؤْلُؤٍ": both are read. Whoever reads "وَلُؤْلُؤًا" takes it in the sense of "they will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and they will be adorned with pearls"; and whoever reads "وَلُؤْلُؤٍ" means "and of pearls". It is also possible that it is "bracelets of gold and pearl", so that there is in them a mixture of the two kinds. It is also read "يَحْلَوْنَ فِيها", in the sense of your saying "حَلِيَ، يَحْلى" when one comes to have jewellery.

zajjaj:25-25.t:
His saying: ﴿إنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ويَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ والمَسْجِدِ الحَرامِ الَّذِي جَعَلْناهُ لِلنّاسِ سَواءً العاكِفُ فِيهِ والبادِ ومَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإلْحادٍ بِظُلْمٍ نُذِقْهُ مِن عَذابٍ ألِيمٍ﴾: the form "يَصُدُّونَ" is an imperfect (future) form conjoined to a past form, because the meaning of "الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا" is "those who are unbelievers"; so it is as though He said: "Indeed the unbelievers and those who bar…". Concerning the khabar (predicate) of "إنَّ" there are two views. One is that it is omitted, so that the meaning is: "Indeed those of this description have perished."
It is also possible — and this is the preferred view — that the khabar is "نُذِقْهُ مِن عَذابٍ ألِيمٍ", so the meaning is: "Indeed the unbelievers and those who deviate in the Sacred Mosque, We shall make them taste a painful punishment." As for His saying, the Exalted: ﴿سَواءً العاكِفُ فِيهِ والبادِ﴾, the reading is the nominative (rafʿ) in "سَواءٌ", and its nominative is from two angles. One is that the complete stop is at ﴿الَّذِي جَعَلْناهُ لِلنّاسِ﴾, as He said: ﴿إنَّ أوَّلَ بَيْتٍ وُضِعَ لِلنّاسِ﴾ [Āl ʿImrān: 96],
and then ﴿سَواءً العاكِفُ فِيهِ والبادِ﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar. It may also be on the pattern of "جَعَلْناهُ سَواءٌ العاكِفُ فِيهِ", so that "سَواءٌ" is nominative as a mubtadaʾ and the khabar here is "العاكِفُ فِيهِ" — I mean the khabar of "سَواءٌ" is "العاكِفُ" — and the clause is the khabar (second object) of "جَعَلْناهُ". [Translator's note: the source says "the reading is the nominative in سَواءٌ" while the verse is quoted with the accusative سَواءً; it is translated as written.]
The explanation of His saying ﴿سَواءً العاكِفُ فِيهِ والبادِ﴾ is that the one residing in Mecca and the one who travels to it from whatever land are equal in dwelling there. It has also been said: "Equal in its merit and in performing the rites are the one devoted to it, residing in the Sanctuary, and the one who travels to it."
His saying: ﴿وَمَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإلْحادٍ بِظُلْمٍ﴾: it has been said that "deviation (الإلحاد) in it" is associating partners with Allah; and it has been said that every wrongdoer in it is a deviator (مُلْحِد). It has come from ʿUmar that hoarding food in Mecca is ilḥād.
